source: ESPN public scoreboard and injuries feeds

Boston Celtics.detail: Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

Dallas Mavericks.detail: Lawal (groin) is out for Tuesday's game against Denver.
Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

Detroit Pistons.detail: Cunningham (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.
The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.
Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Robinson (quadriceps) is considered day-to-day as he progresses in his rehab, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Duren (hamstring) is being assigned to the Motor City Cruise on Wednesday for practice as he ramps up for a return, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Orlando Magic.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.
Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Washington Wizards.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.
The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
